title: create & quality of life

body:
**What is this modpack?**
______________________________________________________________
- this modpack creates mods and improves quality of life. most create mods are ither just many create mods or just quality of life mods, but this adds both quality of life and a good amount of create mods. I have olso have made a server for the modpack.

- This modpack is a mix of a quality of life modpacks and the create modpacks.

- Why is this better than other modpacks? I think this modpack is beater then most create mod packs because it adds a lot of create addons and it adds a lot of quality of life add-ons.

- I also put together a Minecraft server for this modpack, so people like you can join for free and play with your friends.
 
- I plan on updating this modpack in the future and maybe adding my own mods that I have created myself.
